description: Concrete commitments for a dreamteamer workspace — who owes what by when, with an inbox, a board and a by-person view.

dreamteamer.title: Tasks
dreamteamer.description: `tasks`: concrete commitments, each one verb-first line with an optional `assignee` (a `users` record), a `due` date, an `urgent` flag, a free `lane` and an `item` backlink to its source record. Ships the inbox (`/inbox`), the board (`/tasks/board`), the by-person view (`/tasks/by-assignee`) and the `working-with-tasks` skill. With the projects module, a task can name its project or activity.
